people.name: Gibeah
people.line: A city of Benjamin, associated with Saul and atrocities.

people.name: Saul
people.line: First king of Israel, anointed by Samuel

translations.web: Saul also went to his house to Gibeah; and the army went with him, whose hearts God had touched.
translations.bsb: Saul also went to his home in Gibeah, and the men of valor whose hearts God had touched went with him.
translations.kjv: And Saul also went home to Gibeah; and there went with him a band of men, whose hearts God had touched.
translations.asv: And Saul also went to his house to Gibeah; and there went with him the host, whose hearts God had touched.
